description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

AnySignal is developing next-generation RF products and services for space and defense missions. The Associate Embedded Software Engineer develops mission-critical embedded software for advanced radio systems, working across the embedded software stack and collaborating with software, hardware, DSP, and FPGA engineers.
Embedded C++ engineer developing Linux-based radio platforms and hardware-in-the-loop tests for flight-system integration

Responsibilities:
• Own the development of mission-critical embedded C++ running on Linux-based embedded systems
• Collaborate with software, hardware, DSP, and FPGA engineers to define the system requirements, interfaces, and architecture
• Participate in hardware bring-up, schematic reviews, and hands-on debugging of embedded radio platforms
• Build automated hardware-in-the-loop tests to validate system performance and reliability
• Troubleshoot complex technical issues across embedded hardware and software systems
• Work directly with our customers to integrate our products into their flight systems, debug RF links, and ensure mission success

Requirements:
• Working knowledge of C++ or C programming
• Understanding of embedded systems through at least 1 year of relevant experience or equivalent internship, coursework, or hands-on project experience
• Experience developing software on Linux platforms or microcontrollers
• Willingness to learn new technologies and take ownership of technical challenges
• Passion for understanding the hardware that your software talks to

Preferred:
• Experience with network programming, including TCP/IP, UDP, and socket programming
• Understanding of digital signal processing, modem design, and RF communications concepts
• Experience with board bring-up, schematic review, and troubleshooting hardware
• Hands-on experience testing and debugging RF hardware in a lab environment using spectrum analyzers, oscilloscopes, and other RF test equipment
• Experience developing for Xilinx MPSoC-based devices
• Experience with Linux platform development, such as Buildroot, U-Boot, and Xilinx FSBL creation
• Experience writing RTL for FPGAs or software that interacts with the FPGA fabric
• Experience with Python, build systems (CMake, Make, Bazel), and CI pipeline development (GitLab)
• Experience with hardware-in-the-loop testing
• Experience working on robotics, aerospace, communications, or other hardware-focused engineering projects
• To comply with U.S. Government space technology export regulations, including ITAR, applicants must be a U.S. citizen, lawful permanent resident, protected individual under 8 U.S.C. 1324b, or eligible to obtain the necessary authorizations from the U.S. Department of State
